# DropdownMenu

DropdownMenu: a trigger that opens a list of menu items in a floating popup. Positioning and dismissal (outside click, Escape) are Base UI Menu's; the rows are `ButtonItem`, `LinkItem`, `CustomItem` and `Section`, which this folder's `index.js` re-exports.

Also asked as: actions menu, overflow menu, kebab, more actions, context menu, menu button, dropdown button.

**Import:** `import { DropdownMenu } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.stories.jsx` — Overview, Placements, Spacing, WithSections, Loading, LoadFailed, EscapeCloses, MenuKeyboardNavigation, Interactive, Default, Open, CompactRows, DisabledRow, DisabledRowWithReason, HoveredState, KeyboardFocus, OpenMenuEdge

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.mdx`

**Motion:** enter `spatial.fast` + `appearance.fast` · exit `appearance.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations · Motion.

## Usage

Use a dropdown menu for a trigger that opens a list of actions or navigation links. Its rows are Section, Button item, Link item and Custom item, all exported from Dropdown menu. For picking one value from a list of options, use Select: a dropdown menu is for actions, a select is for a value.

`trigger` is the element that opens it, `children` are its rows. `isOpen` and `onOpenChange` make it controlled; left uncontrolled it opens and closes on its own. `placement` and `shouldFlip` govern where it opens and whether it flips when there is no room. `spacing` is `cozy` (40 rows, the default) or `compact` (32). `loading` swaps the rows for one Loading options row while its options are still being fetched; after a failure, `hasError` shows Couldn't load options with a Retry row that calls `onRetry`. A menu never draws skeleton rows.

## Motion

DropdownMenu reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Clips open from the trigger's corner on the side it is aligned to. |
| exit | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades. The exit is the fade. |

## Best practices

### A row closes the menu unless it opts out. {#a-row-closes-the-menu-unless-it-opts-out}

```jsx
// Picking "Rename" closes the menu: the common case for an action list.
<DropdownMenu trigger={<Button text="Actions" iconAfter={<i className="fa-solid fa-chevron-down" />} />}>
    <ButtonItem onClick={onRename}>Rename</ButtonItem>
    <ButtonItem onClick={onArchive}>Archive</ButtonItem>
</DropdownMenu>

// A toggle row that should stay open across repeated picks carries
// `data-keep-open`, as a multi-select tag or filter row does.
<ButtonItem onClick={toggleStarred} isSelected={starred} data-keep-open="true">
    Starred
</ButtonItem>
```

### A static row never closes the menu. {#a-static-row-never-closes-the-menu}

A Custom item with no `component` override (its default, `div`) renders a row that only says its words: nothing to press, nothing to focus, and it leaves the menu open.

### Use a menu for actions and a select for a value. {#use-a-menu-for-actions-and-a-select-for-a-value}

Rows that set a value belong in a Select, which shows the chosen value on its trigger. A dropdown menu's rows do something: rename, archive, share.

### Group related items and keep destructive ones last. {#group-related-items-and-keep-destructive-ones-last}

Order items by task and put Delete at the bottom, away from the common actions.

Do: Delete sits last, after the common actions.
Don't: Delete first puts a risky action at the top.

### Start each item with a verb, in sentence case. {#start-each-item-with-a-verb-in-sentence-case}

Verb-first labels read as actions. All caps and noun-only labels slow scanning.

Do: Verb first, sentence case.
Don't: All caps and noun-only labels.

### Keep item labels short and distinct. {#keep-item-labels-short-and-distinct}

One or two words each. Long, near-identical labels make the choice harder and wrap.

Do: Short, distinct labels.
Don't: Long, near-identical labels.

### Nested menus are not yet built. {#nested-menus-are-not-yet-built}

The public Menu family has no submenu-trigger row of its own yet. Flatten the choices or use sections.

## Accessibility

- **The trigger announces the menu.** Its trigger carries `aria-haspopup="menu"` and an `aria-expanded` that tracks the open state.
- **Arrow keys move between rows**, Enter and Space pick the row at the cursor, and Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.
- **A disabled row cannot be picked**, and the arrow keys skip it. Menu rows are not tab stops, so the arrow-key navigation among the enabled rows is unchanged.
- **Disabled is not color alone:** the row sets `aria-disabled`, and its `description` says why in visible text. A disabled row carries no tooltip.
- **Disable a row only for something the person can fix on the same screen.** Leave an action enabled and explain on press when it is merely not ready, and leave out a row the role can never use.

## Parts

1. **Trigger.** Any element that opens the menu, usually a Button with a chevron.
2. **Menu.** A floating list 4px from the trigger, on the raised surface.
3. **Rows.** Button items, Link items or Custom items, 40 tall at cozy and 32 at compact.
4. **Section title and separator** (optional). Group related rows.

### Menu items

Dropdown menu exports the four row parts: `Section`, `ButtonItem`, `LinkItem` and `CustomItem`. `ButtonItem` runs an action and `LinkItem` navigates with `href`. `CustomItem` renders through a `component` of the caller's choosing, such as a `label` around a checkbox. All three take `elemBefore`, `elemAfter`, `description`, `isSelected` and `isDisabled`. `Section` takes a `title` and `hasSeparator` and groups rows. Arrow keys move between enabled rows and wrap at the ends.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Hovered row | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-hovered`. |
| Pressed row | `--ds-background-neutral-subtle-pressed`. |
| Selected row | `--ds-background-selected`. |
| Focused trigger | A 2px ring in `--ds-border-focused`, 2px off the edge, for keyboard focus only. |
| Disabled row | Text takes `--ds-text-disabled`; the row cannot be picked. Its description keeps `--ds-text-subtle`, so the reason stays readable. |
| Loading | One "Loading options" row with a 16 spinner replaces the rows, in `--ds-text-subtle`. |
| Load failed | A "Couldn't load options" row with an alert icon, then a Retry row. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Row text | `--ds-text`, body default; disabled `--ds-text-disabled`. |
| Row icon | `--ds-icon-subtle`. |
| Row padding, radius | `--space-0625` and `--space-150`; `--radius-050`. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, 2px, 2px offset. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Start each row with a verb: "Rename", "Archive". | A noun with no action: "Name". |
| Use sentence case: "Open report". | Title case: "Open Report". |
| Name the trigger for what the menu holds: "Actions", "Views". | "Menu" or "Click here". |
| Keep section titles to one or two words: "Manage", "Go to". | Sentences as section titles. |
| Put the most common action first. | Order rows alphabetically when use is uneven. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `trigger` | element (required) | — | The element that opens the menu. A `Button` with a chevron is the default pattern. |
| `children` | node | — | The menu's rows: `Section`, `ButtonItem`, `LinkItem`, `CustomItem`. |
| `isOpen` | bool | — | Controlled open state. Pair it with `onOpenChange`; leave it out for an uncontrolled menu. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Whether an uncontrolled menu starts open. |
| `onOpenChange` | func | — | Called with the next open state (a boolean) when the menu opens or closes: trigger press, outside click, Escape or picking a row. |
| `placement` | enum | `'bottom-start'` | Side and alignment against the trigger, such as `bottom-start` (default), `top-end` or `right`. A bare side centers the menu on that side. |
| `shouldFlip` | bool | `true` | Flips to the opposite side when there isn't room. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'cozy'` | `cozy` draws 40px rows (default), `compact` draws 32px. |
| `loading` | bool | `false` | Shows one "Loading options" row, with a spinner, in place of the menu's rows while its options load. Never skeleton rows. |
| `hasError` | bool | `false` | Shows "Couldn't load options" with a Retry row in place of the menu's rows, after loading failed. |
| `onRetry` | func | — | Called when Retry is pressed. The menu stays open. |
| `minWidth` | string | — | Minimum width of the menu list, as a CSS length such as `240px`. |
| `maxHeight` | string | — | Maximum height of the menu list, as a CSS length such as `320px`. |
| `container` | object | — | Where the menu portals to. Defaults to the page. |
| `testId` | string | — | Maps to `data-testid` on the menu popup, for test queries. |
| `id` | string | — | Id set on the menu popup. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the menu popup, beside `plus-dropdown-menu`. |
